title: Goniometry of the Hip, Knee and Ankle — Positions That Make It Fair

hook.en: Hip range hides in the pelvis, knee range hides in the hip and ankle range hides in the knee. Learn the positions that stop two-joint muscles and pelvic tilt from fooling your goniometer.
hook.ur: Hip ki range pelvis mein, knee ki range hip mein aur ankle ki range knee mein chhup jati hai. Woh positions seekhein jo do-joint muscles aur pelvic tilt ko aap ke goniometer ko dhoka dene se rokti hain.

goal.en: By the end, you'll set up hip flexion and abduction, knee flexion and ankle dorsiflexion correctly, name the normal ranges and explain why the knee must be bent for dorsiflexion.
goal.ur: End tak aap hip flexion aur abduction, knee flexion aur ankle dorsiflexion sahi setup karenge, normal ranges batayenge aur samjhayenge ke dorsiflexion ke liye knee mora hua kyun hona chahiye.

text.en: In the lower limb the **joint you measure shares muscles with the joint next to it**. Hamstrings cross the hip and the knee; gastrocnemius crosses the knee and the ankle. If you measure with those muscles stretched, you are testing **muscle length**, not joint range. So we choose positions that keep two-joint muscles slack: hip flexion with the knee bent, knee flexion with the hip flexed, ankle dorsiflexion with the knee bent. Normal ranges (AAOS): hip flexion 0–120°, extension 0–30°, abduction 0–45°, adduction 0–30°, rotations 0–45°; knee flexion 0–135°; ankle dorsiflexion 0–20°, plantarflexion 0–50°.
text.ur: Lower limb mein **jis joint ko aap naap rahe hain woh qareeb ke joint ke saath muscles share karta hai**. Hamstrings hip aur knee dono ko cross karte hain; gastrocnemius knee aur ankle ko. Agar aap in muscles ko stretched halat mein naapein to aap **muscle length** test kar rahe hain, joint range nahi. Is liye aisi positions chunte hain jo do-joint muscles ko dheela rakhein: hip flexion knee mora hua, knee flexion hip flexed, ankle dorsiflexion knee mora hua. Normal ranges (AAOS): hip flexion 0–120°, extension 0–30°, abduction 0–45°, adduction 0–30°, rotations 0–45°; knee flexion 0–135°; ankle dorsiflexion 0–20°, plantarflexion 0–50°.

text.en: A two-joint muscle is a rope tied over two pulleys. If you pull one pulley the rope pulls on the other as well. To measure only one pulley, you must first let the rope go slack over the other. Bending the knee is how you give the hamstring (or gastrocnemius) its slack.
text.ur: Do-joint muscle do pulleys par tangi hui rassi hai. Ek pulley kheenchein to rassi doosri ko bhi kheenchti hai. Sirf ek pulley ko naapne ke liye pehle rassi ko doosri par dheela karna parta hai. Knee mor'na hamstring (ya gastrocnemius) ko yehi dheel dena hai.

beats.title: Hip flexion — the knee bends on purpose

intro.en: Watch the knee flex as the hip flexes: it slackens the hamstrings so they do not limit the range. The pelvis is held steady so it cannot tilt backwards. Axis on the greater trochanter, stationary arm along the lateral pelvis, moving arm toward the lateral epicondyle.
intro.ur: Dekhein hip flex hote hue knee bhi flex hota hai: yeh hamstrings ko dheela karta hai taake woh range limit na karein. Pelvis ko saakin rakha gaya hai taake peechay tilt na ho. Axis greater trochanter par, stationary arm lateral pelvis ke saath, moving arm lateral epicondyle ki taraf.

question.en: Why is the knee allowed to bend during hip flexion measurement?
question.ur: Hip flexion naapte waqt knee ko mor'ne kyun diya jata hai?

text.en: To slacken the hamstrings so they do not limit the joint range
text.ur: Hamstrings ko dheela karne ke liye taake woh joint range limit na karein

feedback.en: Yes — a straight knee would stop the hip at about 80° because of hamstring length, not the hip joint.
feedback.ur: Haan — seedha knee hamstring length ki wajah se hip ko takriban 80° par rok deta, hip joint ki wajah se nahi.

text.en: To make the goniometer easier to read
text.ur: Goniometer parhna aasan karne ke liye

feedback.en: The knee position is about muscle tension, not the dial.
feedback.ur: Knee position muscle tension ke baare mein hai, dial ke baare mein nahi.

text.ur: Knee joint ki hifazat ke liye

feedback.en: The knee is not at risk; the point is the hamstrings.
feedback.ur: Knee khatray mein nahi; asal baat hamstrings hain.

intro.en: The goniometer reads 90° at the start, so you record the **change**. Axis over the ASIS of the tested side, stationary arm along the line to the opposite ASIS, moving arm along the anterior femur toward the middle of the patella. Watch for pelvic hiking (the pelvis tilting sideways).
intro.ur: Goniometer start par 90° parhta hai, is liye aap **tabdeeli** likhte hain. Axis tested side ke ASIS par, stationary arm opposite ASIS ki line ke saath, moving arm anterior femur ke saath patella ke beech ki taraf. Pelvic hiking (pelvis ka side mein tilt) par nazar rakhein.

intro.en: Supine, the hip flexes as the knee bends so the rectus femoris does not limit range. Axis on the lateral epicondyle of the femur, stationary arm toward the greater trochanter, moving arm toward the lateral malleolus. Normal 0–135° with a soft end-feel (calf against thigh).
intro.ur: Supine, knee mor'te hue hip flex hota hai taake rectus femoris range limit na kare. Axis femur ke lateral epicondyle par, stationary arm greater trochanter ki taraf, moving arm lateral malleolus ki taraf. Normal 0–135°, soft end-feel (calf thigh se lagti hai).

intro.en: Sitting with the knee bent at least 30° to slacken the gastrocnemius. Axis at the lateral malleolus, stationary arm toward the fibular head, moving arm parallel to the 5th metatarsal. Record the change from 90°; the end-feel is firm (Achilles and posterior capsule).
intro.ur: Baithe hue, knee kam az kam 30° mora hua taake gastrocnemius dheela ho. Axis lateral malleolus par, stationary arm fibular head ki taraf, moving arm 5th metatarsal ke parallel. 90° se tabdeeli likhein; end-feel firm (Achilles aur posterior capsule).

rows.en: Supine; axis greater trochanter; arms: lateral pelvis, lateral femur
rows.ur: Supine; axis greater trochanter; arms: lateral pelvis, lateral femur

rows.en: 0–120°; posterior pelvic tilt adds false range
rows.ur: 0–120°; posterior pelvic tilt jhoota range add karta hai

rows.en: Supine, pelvis level; axis over the ASIS; arms: line between ASISs, anterior femur
rows.ur: Supine, pelvis level; axis ASIS ke upar; arms: dono ASIS ke beech line, anterior femur

rows.en: 0–45°; pelvic hiking and hip external rotation add range
rows.ur: 0–45°; pelvic hiking aur hip external rotation range add karte hain

rows.en: Supine; axis lateral epicondyle; arms: greater trochanter, lateral malleolus
rows.ur: Supine; axis lateral epicondyle; arms: greater trochanter, lateral malleolus

rows.en: 0–135°; hip rotation or abduction during the movement
rows.ur: 0–135°; movement ke dauran hip rotation ya abduction

rows.en: Sitting, knee bent 30° or more; axis lateral malleolus; arms: fibula, 5th metatarsal
rows.ur: Baithe hue, knee 30° ya zyada mora hua; axis lateral malleolus; arms: fibula, 5th metatarsal

rows.en: 0–20°; subtalar pronation (foot rolling in) adds range
rows.ur: 0–20°; subtalar pronation (foot ka andar ghoomna) range add karta hai

text.en: **Measuring dorsiflexion with the knee straight.** A straight knee stretches the gastrocnemius, which limits the ankle at about 10° in many healthy people, so you can wrongly conclude that the ankle joint is stiff. Measure with the knee bent (joint range, soleus) **and** straight (gastrocnemius length) and compare: a difference of more than a few degrees tells you the problem is the calf muscle, not the joint. Also never forget the 90° starting reading.
text.ur: **Knee seedha rakh kar dorsiflexion naapna.** Seedha knee gastrocnemius ko stretch karta hai jo bohat se healthy logon mein ankle ko takriban 10° par rok deta hai, is liye aap ghalat nateeja nikal sakte hain ke ankle joint sakht hai. Knee mora hua (joint range, soleus) **aur** seedha (gastrocnemius length) dono naap kar compare karein: chand degrees se zyada ka farq batata hai ke masla calf muscle ka hai, joint ka nahi. 90° ki starting reading bhi kabhi na bhoolein.

question.en: Dorsiflexion is 5° with the knee straight and 18° with the knee bent. What does this suggest?
question.ur: Dorsiflexion knee seedha hone par 5° aur mora hone par 18° hai. Yeh kya batata hai?

text.en: Tight gastrocnemius (a muscle-length problem); the ankle joint range is fine
text.ur: Gastrocnemius tight hai (muscle-length masla); ankle joint ki range theek hai

feedback.en: Yes — the range returns when the gastrocnemius is slackened, so the muscle, not the joint, is the limit.
feedback.ur: Haan — gastrocnemius dheela hone par range wapas aati hai, is liye rukawat joint nahi, muscle hai.

feedback.en: A capsular restriction would limit both positions.
feedback.ur: Capsular restriction dono positions mein limit karti.

text.en: A normal ankle with no problem

feedback.en: A 13° difference between positions is clearly meaningful.
feedback.ur: Positions ke beech 13° ka farq wazeh taur par mayne rakhta hai.

text.en: **Match the finding to the treatment.** Reduced dorsiflexion only with the knee straight points to the gastrocnemius, so calf stretching with the knee extended works. Reduced dorsiflexion with the knee bent too points to the soleus or the ankle joint (capsule, or an anterior bony block); there, a weight-bearing lunge, joint mobilisation and soleus stretching are the right tools. Re-measure with the same position after treatment.
text.ur: **Finding ko treatment se milayein.** Sirf knee seedha hone par dorsiflexion kam ho to gastrocnemius ki taraf ishara, is liye knee extended rakh kar calf stretching kaam karti hai. Knee mora hone par bhi dorsiflexion kam ho to soleus ya ankle joint (capsule, ya anterior bony block); wahan weight-bearing lunge, joint mobilisation aur soleus stretching sahi tools hain. Ilaaj ke baad wohi position rakh kar dobara naapein.

question.en: Why does the goniometer read about 90° at the start of ankle dorsiflexion?
question.ur: Ankle dorsiflexion ke start par goniometer takriban 90° kyun parhta hai?

answer.en: Because in the neutral position the foot is at 90° to the leg, so the arms are perpendicular. The movement is the **change** from that: if the dial moves from 90° to 70°, dorsiflexion is **20°**.
answer.ur: Kyunke neutral position mein foot taang se 90° par hota hai, is liye arms perpendicular hoti hain. Movement is se **tabdeeli** hai: dial 90° se 70° par aaye to dorsiflexion **20°** hai.

question.en: Which landmark is the axis for **knee flexion**?
question.ur: **Knee flexion** ke liye axis kaun sa landmark hai?

text.en: The lateral epicondyle of the femur

feedback.en: Yes — the joint's axis is approximately through the lateral epicondyle.
feedback.ur: Haan — joint ka axis takriban lateral epicondyle se guzarta hai.

feedback.en: The patella sits in front and moves; it is not the axis.
feedback.ur: Patella samne hoti hai aur hilti hai; yeh axis nahi.

text.en: **Refer urgently** for a knee that is locked and cannot extend after an injury, a hot swollen joint with fever, a hip that cannot bear weight after a fall (fracture), or a calf that is swollen, red and tender after surgery or a long journey (DVT). Do not stretch or measure through a suspected fracture or DVT.
text.ur: **Foran refer karein** agar chot ke baad knee lock ho kar extend na ho, joint garam sooja aur bukhar ke saath ho, girne ke baad hip wazan na utha sake (fracture), ya surgery ya lambay safar ke baad calf sooji, laal aur tender ho (DVT). Shak-e-fracture ya DVT mein stretch ya measure na karein.

summary.en: Keep two-joint muscles slack when you measure joint range: bend the knee for hip flexion and for ankle dorsiflexion.
summary.ur: Joint range naapte waqt do-joint muscles ko dheela rakhein: hip flexion aur ankle dorsiflexion ke liye knee mora hua rakhein.

summary.en: Normal (AAOS): hip flexion 120°, abduction 45°, knee flexion 135°, ankle dorsiflexion 20°; record the change when the dial starts at 90°.
summary.ur: Normal (AAOS): hip flexion 120°, abduction 45°, knee flexion 135°, ankle dorsiflexion 20°; dial 90° se shuru ho to tabdeeli likhein.

summary.en: Compare knee-bent and knee-straight dorsiflexion to tell a joint problem from a calf-muscle problem and treat accordingly.
summary.ur: Knee mora hua aur seedha dorsiflexion compare kar ke joint ke masle ko calf-muscle ke masle se alag karein aur uske mutabiq ilaaj karein.

front.en: Normal hip flexion, abduction, knee flexion and ankle dorsiflexion?
front.ur: Normal hip flexion, abduction, knee flexion aur ankle dorsiflexion?

front.en: Why bend the knee to measure dorsiflexion?
front.ur: Dorsiflexion naapne ke liye knee kyun mor'te hain?

back.en: It slackens the gastrocnemius so that you measure joint range, not muscle length.
back.ur: Gastrocnemius dheela hota hai taake aap joint range naapein, muscle length nahi.

front.en: Where is the axis for hip abduction?
front.ur: Hip abduction ka axis kahan hai?

back.en: Over the ASIS of the tested side.
back.ur: Tested side ke ASIS ke upar.

front.ur: Hip flexion ko kaun si ghalti phulati hai?

note.en: Measure every hip, knee and ankle movement in 3D.
note.ur: Har hip, knee aur ankle movement 3D mein measure karein.

note.en: Test hamstrings, hip flexors and calf length in 3D.
note.ur: Hamstrings, hip flexors aur calf length 3D mein test karein.
